proposed.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
proposed.text: Ross secretly passes Ramonda word of the United States' plans against Wakanda. After she dies in Namor's attack, Valentina arrests him for his contact with her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Wakanda's queen, whom Ross secretly feeds U.S. intelligence until her death.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: CIA agent who secretly warns Ramonda of U.S. plans against Wakanda.

changes.evidence: In Wakanda Forever Ross talks with Ramonda over Kimoyo beads, agrees to warn her if the U.S. moves against Wakanda, and tells her of the President's plans; after her death Valentina arrests him for treason over his contact with Ramonda.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Kurse kills Frigga when Malekith attacks the palace. Odin holds his wife's body and mourns her at her funeral.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Frigga's husband, who holds her body after Malekith's attack.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Odin's wife and queen, killed in Malekith's attack on the palace.

changes.evidence: Thor: The Dark World: Frigga and Odin part as the Dark Elves attack; Kurse kills Frigga and Odin holds her lifeless body; she gets a funeral at which Odin sends her off. A death is a stage.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
proposed.text: Gamora and Groot first meet brawling over the Orb on Xandar, escape the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. Groot gives his life to shield the team when the Dark Aster crashes.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian, who gives his life to shield the team.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian, first met brawling over the Orb on Xandar.

changes.evidence: The Xandar fight over the Orb, the Kyln and the founding of the Guardians all happen in Guardians of the Galaxy (2014), where Groot also dies shielding the group; the only stage sits on Vol. 2, so the connection starts too late.

now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
now.text: Gamora and Groot first meet brawling over the Orb on Xandar and become founding Guardians. She looks out for the young Groot in battle, warning him out of harm's way during the fight with the Abilisk.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian, whom Gamora looks out for as a youngster.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian, who looks out for Groot in battle.

proposed.text: Gamora looks out for the young Groot in battle, warning him out of harm's way during the fight with the Abilisk.

changes.evidence: Stage 0 is on Vol. 2 but its first sentence (meeting on Xandar, founding the Guardians) is Guardians of the Galaxy (2014), now its own stage. In Vol. 2 Gamora tells the dancing Baby Groot to get out of the way during the Abilisk fight.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Thanos tortures the captive Nebula, and Gamora gives up the Soul Stone's location to save her sister. Thanos then sacrifices Gamora on Vormir.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Sister whose torture makes Gamora give up the Soul Stone.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Sister who gives up the Soul Stone to save Nebula from torture.

changes.evidence: Infinity War: Thanos kidnaps Gamora, who discloses the Soul Stone's location to save Nebula from torture; he then sacrifices Gamora.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: The future Nebula tells a Gamora from 2014 that they become sisters, and Gamora frees her to stop Thanos. When the 2014 Nebula refuses to change sides and aims at Gamora, the future Nebula kills her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Sister from the future, who wins this younger Gamora to her side.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Gamora from 2014, who frees Nebula after learning they become sisters.

changes.evidence: Endgame: present-day Nebula convinces 2014-Gamora to betray Thanos; Gamora frees her after Nebula says they become sisters; 2014-Nebula refuses to change and tries to shoot Gamora, and present Nebula kills her.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Quill keeps trying to win back the Gamora from 2014, who rejects him and lashes out when he compares her to his Gamora. At the end he accepts who she is, and they part warmly when she leaves with the Ravagers.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A former teammate who finally accepts she isn't his Gamora. They part warmly.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Gamora from 2014 who rejects Quill, then parts from him warmly.

changes.evidence: Vol. 3: Quill tells Gamora he loves her and hopes they can get back together; she says there is no chance and attacks him for comparing her to his Gamora. Before leaving with the Ravagers she tells him she is still not who he wants, he has accepted it, and she says she imagines they were fun together.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Thanos from 2014 learns of his future and brings a younger Gamora with him to 2023. Unsettled by what she learns, she frees the captive Nebula and turns against him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Adoptive father, whose 2014 self this younger Gamora defects from.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Adopted daughter. A Gamora from 2014 turns against him in 2023.

changes.evidence: Endgame: 2014-Thanos and 2014-Gamora watch Nebula's memories of his future; he brings her to 2023, where present-day Nebula convinces 2014-Gamora to betray Thanos and she defects.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Rocket, helps the Guardians hunt for the code to save his life, and on Counter-Earth she shields the dying Rocket from Adam Warlock and War Pig.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian this Gamora never knew, whom she shields while he lies dying.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Gamora from 2014, a stranger who shields Rocket while he lies dying.

changes.evidence: Vol. 3: the 2014 Gamora, now a Ravager, helps the Guardians infiltrate Orgocorp to find Rocket's override code, and on Counter-Earth saves Rocket from Adam and War Pig.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Groot goes with Rocket and Thor to Nidavellir and fights beside them in Wakanda. In the Snap he turns to dust in front of Rocket, calling out to him as he fades.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Groot's surrogate father, who watches him fade in the Snap.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The young Groot Rocket raises, who fades to dust in front of him.

changes.evidence: Infinity War: Groot travels with Rocket and Thor to Nidavellir and fights in Wakanda; in the Snap he disintegrates, calling to Rocket as he fades. A death is a stage.

proposed.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
proposed.text: Hank has cut Scott off for two years, angry that taking the suit to Germany forced him and Hope into hiding. When Scott gets a message from Janet, Hank brings him back in, and they work together to rescue her from the Quantum Realm.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hank's pupil, cut off over Germany, then brought back to help rescue Janet.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Scott's mentor, angry with him over Germany, who brings him back to rescue Janet.

changes.evidence: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Lang contacts Pym 'despite the strained relationship they have because of Lang's actions with the Avengers'; Pym had no contact with him for two years and is still upset, but the trio work together and Pym rescues Janet.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs the simulation that cracks time travel for Tony. After he uses the Stones to beat Thanos, she reports to Pepper that his life functions are critical as he dies.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, whose dying moments she reports after the Battle of Earth.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I., who helps him crack time travel and reports him dying.

changes.evidence: Endgame: Tony asks F.R.I.D.A.Y. for the Mobius-strip simulation that solves time travel; after he uses the Stones, Pepper asks her for a scan and she replies his life functions are critical. A death is a stage.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Tony dies after using the Stones to beat Thanos. Happy mourns him at the funeral and promises his daughter Morgan all the cheeseburgers she wants, as her father liked.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Happy's boss and old friend, who dies after the Battle of Earth.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's old friend, who mourns him and looks after his daughter.

changes.evidence: Endgame: after Tony's sacrifice Happy attends the funeral and sits with Morgan, telling her her father liked cheeseburgers too. A death is a stage.

proposed.title: Secret Invasion
proposed.text: Talos tells G'iah that her mother is dead, killed by Gravik, the rebel leader G'iah has been working for.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: G'iah's mother, killed by Gravik while G'iah works for him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Soren's daughter, who learns from Talos that Gravik killed her.

changes.evidence: Secret Invasion, 'Resurrection': Talos tells G'iah 'Your mother died while you were working for her killer'; Soren was killed by Gravik without G'iah's knowledge. A death is a stage.

proposed.title: Loki S2#4
proposed.text: Miss Minutes shows Renslayer a memory of her building the TVA beside He Who Remains, who then had her memories of their partnership erased. Angered, Renslayer decides to run the TVA without him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: TVA judge who built it beside him, then learns he erased her memories.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's founder, who built it with Renslayer, then erased her memories.

changes.evidence: Loki S2 'Heart of the TVA': a memory shows Renslayer and He Who Remains admiring the nearly finished Citadel and TVA, after which he has Miss Minutes erase her memories; angered, Renslayer and Miss Minutes decide to lead the TVA without any He Who Remains variant.

proposed.title: Loki S2#3
proposed.text: Miss Minutes carries out He Who Remains' plan for Victor Timely and reveals she loved her creator, who kept her as his assistant and never gave her a body. When Timely rejects her, she turns against her creator's wishes.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: His A.I., who loved him and resented being kept as his tool.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Miss Minutes' creator, whom she loved, but who kept her as his assistant.

changes.evidence: Loki S2 '1893': Miss Minutes tells Timely that He Who Remains created her, they were 'more than friends', and he kept her as 'your computer, your toy' instead of giving her a body; after Timely rejects her she decides not to honor He Who Remains' wishes.

owner_calls.question: Eros and Thanos never share a screen. Pip calls Eros 'brother to Thanos'. Does a stated sibling tie count as knowing each other, or is this a blood tie never met?
options: Keep: brothers raised on Titan, tie stated on screen
owner_calls.evidence: Eros appears only in the Eternals mid-credits scene, introduced by Pip as Eros, prince of Titan, brother to Thanos. Nothing on screen shows them meeting.
